items.source: NOTE: @RestController is processed if an appropriate HandlerMapping-HandlerAdapter pair is configured such as the RequestMappingHandlerMapping-RequestMappingHandlerAdapter pair which are the default in the MVC Java config and the MVC namespace.
items.translation: 注意： 如果配置了适当的 HandlerMapping-HandlerAdapter 配对（例如在 MVC Java 配置和 MVC 命名空间中默认的 RequestMappingHandlerMapping-RequestMappingHandlerAdapter 配对），则会处理 @RestController。

items.source: Types that carry this annotation are treated as controllers where @RequestMapping methods assume @ResponseBody semantics by default.
items.translation: 带有此注解的类型被视为控制器，其中`@RequestMapping`方法默认采用`@ResponseBody`语义。

items.source:
The value may indicate a suggestion for a logical component name,
to be turned into a Spring bean in case of an autodetected component.
items.translation: 该值可能表示逻辑组件名称的建议，在检测到自动组件时将其转换为 Spring  Bean。

items.source: the suggested component name, if any (or empty String otherwise)
items.translation: 建议的组件名称（如果有，否则为空字符串）
